event.title: Air Traffic Control Issues Cause Disruptions at Rome Airport
event.canonical_title: Air Traffic Control Issues Cause Disruptions at Rome Airport
event.summary: On October 16, flight delays and cancellations occurred at Rome's Fiumicino Airport due to a fault in the data-transmission network of Italy's nationwide air traffic control system. The disruptions affected numerous flights throughout the day.
